description: A photograph captures a sunlit natural grassland landscape featuring a gently sloping hillside in the midground and background. The hillside is covered with dry, light brown and green grasses, dotted with numerous scattered, conical-shaped dark green shrubs or small trees, resembling junipers. The crest of the hill in the background shows a denser line of taller deciduous trees under a clear blue sky. In the foreground, on the lower left, a vibrant yellow agricultural field, likely rapeseed, is visible. This image visually represents a land cover type that could be classified as "natural grassland" or "dry grassland" with "small woody features" (SWF) or scrub, aligning with definitions used in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) High Resolution Layers (HRL) or CORINE Land Cover (CLC) classifications, particularly CLC 3.2.1 for natural grasslands.
